og_title: Terracotta Bird Planter | Handmade India – Pipihiri
og_description:
Give your plants and home a new look with our colourful Pipihiri Terracotta Hanging Bird Planter. Terracotta is the best material, as plants thrive in it since terracotta absorbs water, allowing the soil to retain some moisture even if you forget to water it for a while. This Pipihri Terracotta Hanging Bird Planter can be used to beautify your home, balcony, and garden. Also use it as a corporate gift or for gifting friends and relatives.

This product is handmade, and each piece is unique! Due to the differences in displays of computers/laptops/phones, the colours on your screen may vary marginally from the actual colours of the product.

Material: Terracotta

Colour: Pink, Yellow

Use: Hanging planter for plants

Size: 7.5*7.5*5 inches. Approx.

Care: Wash directly with running water using your hands. Do not use any soap or detergent.

📦 Terracotta is fragile. Please start recording a video before you open your parcel. If anything arrives damaged, send us the video within 24 hours of delivery and we'll replace it or refund you. Read the damage policy
